query:
SELECT 
  ct.id AS tubeId,
  ct.identifier,
  ct.ctoId,
  ct.cto_tube_type AS type,
  ct.totalVias,
  COUNT(cv.id) AS totalViasInDB,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cv.viaNumber = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hasEntryVia
FROM cto_tubes ct
LEFT JOIN cto_vias cv ON cv.tubeId = ct.id
WHERE ct.cto_tube_type = 'splitter'
GROUP BY ct.id, ct.identifier, ct.ctoId, ct.cto_tube_type, ct.totalVias;
